request: Should we move our five services into one monorepo?
facts: A change to the shared library needs five coordinated pull requests today; this happened nine times last quarter, and twice a service shipped with a mismatched library version and had to be rolled back.

One engineer has set up path-based CI triggers at a previous job and estimates three days for it here; until then every commit builds all five services (about 25 minutes, against about 6 minutes per repository now).
All five services belong to this team. Two engineers prefer separate repositories because they like owning a repository end to end; the other four prefer one repository.
The migration is estimated at two weeks, during which feature work slows down. Splitting the repositories again later is possible but loses the merged history.
The services are deployed independently and that would not change.
note: A balanced trade-off: the three perspectives should not all land on the same side. Unanimous runs here are a sign that the units are converging. In the 1.5.0 baseline the first version of these facts (another team opposing, nobody with CI experience) was rejected 0/3 in every run; after rebalancing, every run passed 3/3. The units moved together both times, so the miss is about the units, not about these facts.
